_comment: Copy to google-mcp.json and adapt to the Google Workspace MCP server you install. The READ-ONLY guarantee comes from the OAuth scopes you grant during auth (gmail.readonly + calendar.readonly) — see README. The agents.json allowed_tools list is a second layer: only read tools are ever permitted. Tool names below must match your server's actual tool names; update agents.json -> inbox-digest.allowed_tools to match.
